label: Aruba Instant On AP12 (RW) 3x3 11ac Wave2 Indoor Access Point (R2X01A)
description: Aruba Instant On AP12 (R2X01A) - dual-radio 802.11ac Wave 2 indoor AP, 3x3:3 on both bands (300 Mbps 2.4 GHz + 1.3 Gbps 5 GHz). Single 1G RJ45 uplink with 802.3af PoE-in or 12 V DC; supports Instant On gateway/router mode.
